I want 1,000 fakes. Each slot needs an 80-unit deposit: 80,000 locked first. The raven is the deposit.
Each epoch, a VRF beacon draws 7 jurors. Flagged fakes burn it. Two strikes freeze deposits 20 epochs. The karst is hollow: one bad slot traps all.
My math: 1,000 slots cost 80,000. At 30% flagged, each round burns 24,000. Honest workers get deposits back in 3 epochs; I don't. The tide runs one way: 80,000 up front, 24,000 a round until broke.
